reason: I verified the tower-field construction by hand: _TO_TOWER correctly maps the GF(2^8) generator x (a root of t^8+t^4+t^3+t+1, confirmed by checking φ(x)^8+φ(x)^4+φ(x)^3+φ(x)+1 = 0 in GF(2^4)[y]/(y^2+y+z^3)), the table entries match the successive powers of φ(x), and _FROM_TOWER is its exact inverse (composition returns 1,2,4,...,128 on each basis bit). The norm/power-14/inverse formulas, the GF(16) multiplier with modulus 0x13, the zero case (0 → 0x63), and the affine step (rotations by 1..4 XOR 0x63, matching bit indices i+4..i+7) are all correct; masking, fresh output allocation, and storage-offset handling are also sound.
